chunks: From him, from Abu Ja'far, from his father Wahb, from Ja'far, from Ali (peace be upon him)
That he disliked taking a wage from the market of the Muslims.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali dislike regarding taking wages from the Muslim market?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) discouraged accepting payment from the general Muslim market for specific services, reflecting a preference for gratuitous service (i'ta') over commercial transaction within the community. This stance, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, highlights the Shia emphasis on distinguishing between professional trade and acts of religious or social duty, ensuring that spiritual or communal benefits remain accessible without the barrier of market pricing.
